purpose: Determine the exact status of the V40 U(1)_F cross anomaly block against the V38 X/H lifts without relabelling an EFT threshold as a UV completion.

assumptions: Every full-rank heavy mass entry is a polynomial in ThetaPlus/ThetaMinus VEVs and has total F charge 9 n for an integer n.
Those Higgs fields are X/H neutral, so a mass block connects states of fixed (X,H)=(x,h) only to states of (-x,-h).
The ordinary threshold has no additional VEV carrying nonzero X or H charge.
residual_preserving_theta_threshold_no_g.conclusion: No finite collection of ordinary Theta-only residual-preserving pairs can cancel V40's C_F_X_H=+6 row: their total shift is always a multiple of nine.  This is independent of their X/H charges and is the decisive obstruction.
residual_preserving_theta_threshold_no_g.consequence: Every such full-rank ordinary threshold shifts C_F_X_H by 0 modulo 9.
full_rank_block_extension: For a nonzero determinant monomial of a block, every selected entry obeys f_i+g_sigma(i)=9 n_i.
Summing it gives sum_i f_i + sum_j g_j in 9 Z.
The whole block contributes C_F_X_H=(sum_i f_i+sum_j g_j) x h, hence is in 9 Z.
Adding blocks preserves the congruence, so the conclusion does not rely on diagonal pairwise masses.

restricted_two_pair_minimality.conclusion: Two mass pairs (four chiral singlets) are minimal within this explicitly stated class.
restricted_two_pair_minimality.restricted_class: Pati--Salam-singlet pairs with F charges (f,-f), each massed by one P or Pb insertion, so the threshold does not alter F^3, F-gravity, or F-PS^2.

same_orientation_ring_preservation.conditional_result: With <Chi>=0, the V40 all-declared-VEV proof for same-orientation Q4/Qc4 sources survives exactly.  A full potential proof of <Chi>=0 and a mixed-operator/proton calculation remain open.
same_orientation_ring_preservation.ward_identity: Integrating out fields with U(1)_F-preserving P/Pb masses cannot generate an operator whose external Z9 charge is nonzero.  Theta VEV insertions can change a U(1)_F charge only by 9k.

simple_quantized_GS_subcase.additional_boundary: An axion that shifts only under F cannot by itself cancel the F^2-X row under an X gauge variation.
simple_quantized_GS_subcase.not_excluded: A specified multi-axion/Stueckelberg/generalized-Chern--Simons or topological response with its full integral charge lattice and anomaly polynomial.  No such UV datum is supplied here.
simple_quantized_GS_subcase.scope: Single compact axion, shifting only under U(1)_F by its minimal residual-preserving charge 9, with integer Chern--Weil levels in the same one-leg convention q_F k=A used by the V38 audit.

why_full_product_parent_is_not_claimed: The pre-existing V38 X^3, X^2H, XH^2, gravitational, and discrete-R/product-bordism rows are not cancelled here.
The P/Pb threshold breaks the old U(1)_X/Z66 direction and lies outside the V38 residual-preserving no-go assumptions.
The exact F/D/soft vacuum, threshold matching, kinetic mixing, perturbative running, and all mixed baryon operators remain uncomputed.
A multi-axion or topological GS completion requires a specified quantized charge lattice and is not inferred from arithmetic alone.
